name: otel-otlp-logs
producer: OpenTelemetry SDK/Collector, OTLP log records (open specification)
description: Mapped from opentelemetry-proto logs.proto. OTLP carries dropped_attributes_count and friends, which count ATTRIBUTES dropped from a surviving record; there is no in-band counter for dropped records themselves, no sequence number and no integrity field. Loss is reported on the Collector's separate internal-telemetry metrics path (otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records, otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_log_records) and in the OTLP response's partial_success.rejected_log_records — neither of which travels with the data.

loss.note: BatchLogRecordProcessor drops on a full queue; the count lives on the metrics path, not here.

independence.boundary_statement: The SDK runs inside the audited process; the Collector runs beside it and records only what the SDK chose to emit.
